title: Inter Wasted Esposito’s Hat-Trick: 4–4 at Atalanta | Nerazzurri Daily
description:
Francesco Pio Esposito scored three in Bergamo — and Inter still only drew 4–4 with Atalanta.
Free daily digest in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=83

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Atalanta 4–4 Inter: Esposito scored at 16′, 32′ and 52′; Inter led by two goals three times and Atalanta tied it with a stoppage-time penalty (Inter.it, Nov 22).
CONFIRMED — Chivu: “For me, that’s two points thrown away, but we have to learn from it” (Inter.it, Nov 22).
REPORTED — Çalhanoğlu may have a hamstring injury and risks missing the rest of 2026: Tuttosport and Sportmediaset (Nov 22). The club confirms only that he went off injured.
